lead: An image grid with states: each cell is loading (a placeholder, with optional progress), ready (opens a full-screen preview that switches through the group) or failed (a reason and a retry). Cells share one aspect ratio and the column count follows the number of images. It is general-purpose: several images generated by an AI at once, batch uploads, batch processing results; in [AI Chat](/ai-chat) it is the set of images in an assistant reply.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Click any image to open the preview; the arrow keys or the side buttons switch between the images of the grid.

states.title: States
states.description: `loading` (with a progress bar only when `progress` is given), `ready` and `error` (with a retry button only when `onRetry` is given).

generating.title: Generating
generating.description: Four images generated at once: each shows its own progress and appears when done; the third fails and succeeds after a retry.

actions.title: Actions and Remove
actions.description: `actions` holds the actions at the bottom of a cell, written with `ImageGrid.Action` (they appear on hover or keyboard focus); `onRemove` adds a remove button to the top right of each cell.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The list (`ul`); `data-columns`, `data-ratio`; `aria-busy` while some cells aren't ready
styling.loading: The loading placeholder (a shimmer) and its status text
styling.progress: The progress bar (`role=progressbar`); the fill reads `--grid-progress`
styling.error: A failed cell, its reason and the retry button
styling.actions: The action area at the bottom of a ready cell and its buttons
styling.remove: The remove button in the top right
styling.image: A ready cell holds an Image (previews are grouped with `Image.PreviewGroup`)
